messages:
AcmeCorp (Customer): Hey @Maya — our production app had a hard stop at ~10:10 UTC this morning, tokens went to 0 even though our monthly allotment should refill on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. We did a tenant ownership transfer last week. Can you check?

Maya (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the response headers from one of the failing requests (we're looking for things like `x-credits-remaining`, `x-reset-at`, `x-request-id`)? Also can you confirm org id and when the transfer happened?

AcmeCorp (Customer): quick paste from our app log (redacted):

```
RequestId: rq_01F8K2
x-credits-remaining: 0
x-reset-at: 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z
x-rate-limit: 120/ms
x-account-id: acct_98765
```

Transfer completed: 2026-09-18T14:22:00Z (UTC). Our org billing cycle has always been first-of-month UTC. We expected a refill at 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z, but the stop happened earlier this morning (09-30, 10:10 UTC) when traffic spiked.

Maya (Support): cc @Nate @Kevin @Priya — looks like a tricky one, assigning.

Nate (SRE): Thanks — digging into logs now. Two quick hypotheses: 1) the transfer changed the billing anchor so the system thought the account was mid-cycle and applied pro-rata (which should have given them a partial refill) but a bug returned 0; 2) there was a race during ownership handoff where quota bookkeeping temporarily pointed to the old owner and depleted the pooled credits.

Nate (SRE): Repro steps I'm running locally:
1) create org A with monthly allotment 10M tokens, reset day 1 00:00 UTC
2) consume 9.9M tokens
3) transfer billing ownership to org B (simulate our tenant migration flow)
4) call refill job for org B at scheduled time

Observed: sometimes `quota_service.apply_pro_rata()` returns `null` and the `credits_remaining` field is left uninitialized -> treated as 0. Adding logs now.

Priya (Platform): If that's consistent with the repro it's a bug in the transfer path. We have a migration flag `preserve_billing_anchor` that should be honored. Looks like the flag wasn't set for external transfers triggered by support ticket flows.

Kevin (Billing): We should avoid customer impact while we patch. Maya — can we do a manual interim top-up (pro-rated for the remaining period) and set a monthly_reset_override for Acct acct_98765? I'll need the invoice id + org billing contact to authorize credits.

Maya (Support): @AcmeCorp can you share the billing email or invoice number? Also what token buffer do you need to stay online?

AcmeCorp (Customer): We need ~2M tokens to ride out the month, invoice is INV-2026-2298, billing@acme.example.com. Appreciate the quick help.

billing-bot: Manual credit pending approval. Payload: `{ "account": "acct_98765", "amount": "2,000,000_tokens", "reason": "emergency_pro_rata_topup" }`

Kevin (Billing): Approved and applied a provisional credit of 2,000,000 tokens. Set `monthly_reset_override` = `2026-10-01T00:00:00Z` for this account to avoid double-reset. Ticket created: https://redwood.internal/ISSUES/INF-7342 (internal).

Nate (SRE): After the credit was applied I replayed the spike at 10:12 UTC and the system returned `x-credits-remaining: 1_900_000` and allowed traffic. Root cause confirmed: `preserve_billing_anchor` was not propagated for transfers created via the support transfer API; fallback path left `credits_remaining` uninitialized.

Priya (Platform): Patch submitted: https://redwood.internal/PRs/4521 — it adds explicit anchor carryover and a guard to ensure `credits_remaining` is set to 0 only if an account truly has 0 tokens. Rolling canary to prod in ~30m.

Kevin (Billing): Actions taken: 1) manual provisional credit applied (2M tokens) 2) monthly_reset_override set 3) invoice flagged so finance won't double-charge 4) follow-up refund/adjustment as needed after root cause fix.

Maya (Support): @AcmeCorp can you confirm your service is OK now? Also I'll follow up with a post-incident note once PR deploys. :thumbsup:

AcmeCorp (Customer): Confirmed, traffic is back to normal, no more 429s. Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround.

Maya (Support): Closing loop: we've applied the provisional credit and set the override. PR 4521 will prevent this on future transfers; INF-7342 will track retrospective adjustments for accounts affected between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-19. We'll reach out if we need more info.

Nate (SRE): Leaving one follow-up: run a backfill job to identify accounts with transfers in that window where `credits_remaining` was possibly left null. I can run a script: `scripts/find_null_credits --start 2026-09-15 --end 2026-09-19` and plan a batch fix.

Kevin (Billing): I'll coordinate finance for any customer refunds or pro-rata adjustments once the backfill results are in.

Maya (Support): Thanks team — marking as resolved for AcmeCorp. If anything else pops up, reopen. :white_check_mark:
